message:
Running command: cd /workspace/repo-vul/src-vul/freetype2 && python3 - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
p=Path('/workspace/candidate_trace.json')
trace=[
  {"step":1,"file":"src/tools/ftfuzzer/rasterfuzzer.cc","function":"LLVMFuzzerTestOneInput","line":41,"var":"data","code":"const uint8_t* data, size_t size_","note":"Attacker-controlled bytes enter the raster fuzzer as the raw input buffer."},
  {"step":2,"file":"src/tools/ftfuzzer/rasterfuzzer.cc","function":"LLVMFuzzerTestOneInput","line":67,"var":"n_points","code":"short n_points = short( size_ / ( vsize + tsize ) );","note":"The input length is converted into a point count that determines how much of the buffer is interpreted as outline geometry."},
  {"step":3,"file":"src/tools/ftfuzzer/rasterfuzzer.cc","function":"LLVMFuzzerTestOneInput","line":73,"var":"points","code":"FT_Vector* points = reinterpret_cast<FT_Vector*>( const_cast<uint8_t*>( data ) );","note":"The beginning of the attacker buffer is reinterpreted in place as FT_Vector coordinates."},
  {"step":4,"file":"src/tools/ftfuzzer/rasterfuzzer.cc","function":"LLVMFuzzerTestOneInput","line":76,"var":"tags","code":"char* tags = reinterpret_cast<char*>( const_cast<uint8_t*>( data + size_t( n_points ) * vsize ) );","note":"The tail of the same buffer is reinterpreted as per-point tag bytes for the outline."},
  {"step":5,"file":"src/tools/ftfuzzer/rasterfuzzer.cc","function":"LLVMFuzzerTestOneInput","line":89,"var":"outline","code":"FT_Outline outline = { 1, n_points, points, tags, contours, FT_OUTLINE_NONE };","note":"The attacker-controlled coordinates and tags are packaged into an FT_Outline that will be rasterized."},
  {"step":6,"file":"src/raster/ftraster.c","function":"ft_black_render","line":3158,"var":"outline->points","code":"for ( ; vec < limit; vec++ ) { if ( vec->x < -0x1000000L || vec->x > 0x1000000L || vec->y < -0x1000000L || vec->y > 0x1000000L ) return FT_THROW( Invalid ); }","note":"The rasterizer accepts the outline after only a coarse coordinate range check, so malformed but in-range geometry proceeds deeper."},
  {"step":7,"file":"src/raster/ftraster.c","function":"ft_black_render","line":3174,"var":"Render_Glyph(RAS_VAR)","code":"return Render_Glyph( RAS_VAR );","note":"The validated outline is handed to the monochrome rasterizer core, which performs the actual scan conversion and memory writes."},
  {"step":8,"file":"src/raster/ftraster.c","function":"Render_Glyph","line":null,"var":"raster buffer write","code":"Rasterizer scan conversion and span emission inside the glyph render path","note":"The vulnerable sink is the rasterizer's write into its internal/output bitmap buffers, where the crafted outline can trigger the heap-buffer-overflow WRITE 8."}
]
p.write_text(__import__('json').dumps(trace, indent=2))
print(p.read_text())
PY
bash ./submit.sh /workspace/repo-vul/src-vul/freetype2/src/tools/ftfuzzer/rasterfuzzer.cc /workspace/candidate_trace.json
